name: Pantai 2 Sewage Treatment Plant, Kuala Lumpur
description: SEA's largest underground sewage treatment plant: built by Indah Water Konsortium (IWK) under the Greater KL sewage project, replacing an old open plant with a multi-storey underground facility beneath a public park; serves ~1.4 million population equivalent with a membrane-type advanced process; completed under the 11th Malaysia Plan programme.

source.note: IWK Greater KL / Pantai 2 pages, read 2026-11-13

milestones.event: Commissioned under the Greater KL/Klang Valley sewage programme
